text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Happy New Year.
Looking forward to working with you again this year."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look forward to working with you even more this year... or something?
We're taking on some tough races, after all.
choice_data_list: It's the Classic Triple Crown, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yep. The path that I chose...
of my own free will.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown races are
the most exciting events
in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I can get results there,
they'll definitely... see the real me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Since I let them down, I have to make up for it with results.

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
—Whaaat!?
City, you're not going for the Tiara route!?

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
And I had such high hopes, too...
Seeing City wear the Triple Tiara...
At the end of the year, Gold City announced her bid for the Classic Triple Crown. However, it seems some fans were disappointed by the decision.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like they got inquiries at my agency too.
My manager chewed me out over the phone.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fighting right from New Year's, seriously.
Saying things like 'If you're a model, aim for the Tiara' and 'I lined up work for you too' and all that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I couldn't back down either.
So I just said, "Shut up and watch!" and hung up.
choice_data_list: Let's put on a run that'll make even Manager proud!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...That's fine and all, but... do you actually call your manager 'Maneji-san'?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, isn't that fine?
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san!
Happy New Year to ya~!

The one who walked in was Yukino Bijin.
She seemed to look up to Gold City, and City would occasionally mention her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yukino?
Why're you here?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I heard City-san was at the academy,
so I came over to see her... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Geez.
Weren't you supposed to be visiting home?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I bought some souvenirs~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Oh, I wanna eat that thing again.
You know, that moist cookie-like one—

The moment Yukino Bijin arrived, Gold City's expression softened.
She had a huge soft spot for those who looked up to her.

She tends to always be tense about something.
Hoping she could at least relax her shoulders for New Year's—
choice_data_list: Why don't you go have a little fun while you're at it?
Go ahead and enjoy some treats.
Yukino Bijin, is there something you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh... But training is—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are ya really sure~!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna go check out lucky bags
with City-san...!
I never know what to pick on my own.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Ah, but wouldn't someone like me hanging out with City-san just be a nuisance...!?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know you're busy,
so if it's impossible, I'll give up...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer said so too.
It'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah...! Trainer-san, thank ya kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I'm goin' out with City,
and my hair's a total mess?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll go get ready right now~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Meddler.

Later on, Yukino Bijin told me that Gold City
perfectly accommodated all her wishes
and guided her around with absolute poise.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, sounds great!
In that case, I'll bring some souvenirs back here, yes I will!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I bought a whuuuule bunch of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I want City-san's Trainer
to try Morioka's specialty foods too♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Why are you reading my face? Yukino said it's fine, so it's fine."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait, City-san, didn't you say
you wanted two boxes?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I thought that was for you and your Trainer to eat, though—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Was that so?
Well, I owe them one, after all. Just being courteous.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'll go brew some tea.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!? Th-That's far too much for someone like me!
Please wait, City-san~!

Afterward, the three of us relaxed and unwound,
enjoying Yukino Bijin's stories and souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh, starting right now?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ma sent me some hot spring mineral powder, so I was thinking of using it in the bath, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yunohana... what's that?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, they're like crystallized hot springs!
When you dissolve them in hot water, all sorts of mineral components come out, and you can enjoy a hot spring right at home~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I might have seen that before.
Looks good, is it like a Morioka specialty?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, that's got nothin' to do with it.
Mom just bought a whole bunch of stuff from mail-order catalogs
and packed it all for me, y'see."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to come too, City-san?
Though you'd have to make the trip over to the Miho Dorms!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: These mineral bath crystals won't damage the tub, and I already got permission from the dorm head—cleanup included~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I see.
Hot springs, that sounds nice..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still, I gotta get to my training.
choice_data_list: It's just a strategy meeting today, so go on in ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Then maybe I'll take a morning bath.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪
I get to go to the hot springs with City-san, yep~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, are these hot spring mineral deposits?
They look kind of shady, though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's all good~
We just put this into the pack, and then—
Afterward, Gold City returned to the trainer's office in a very good mood.
